name: Shandong Linglong Tyre Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Linglong Tyre Co.,Ltd. engages in the design, development, manufacture, sale, and servicing of tires in the People's Republic of China. It offers passenger and light truck radial, truck and bus radial, and off-the-road tires. The company's products are used in passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and engineering machinery. It also sells its products to approximately 173 countries, including Europe, the Middle East, the Americas, the Asia Pacific, Africa, and internationally. The company offers its products under the LINGLONG, ATLAS, LEAO, CROSSWIND, GREENMAX, and EVOLUXX brands.
